location.accessibility: Main entrance to the Warrens; the corridor is narrow but navigable. Trap and spatial confusion present hazards.
location.adventureSummary: The Veilsplit Threshold sets the tone for the Warrens, introducing reality-warping hazards, environmental confusion, and hints of the dangers to come.
dcChecks: Perception DC 13: Notice the faint outline of the pressure plate.
Arcana DC 15: Identify the runes' connection to planar boundaries.
location.description: A twisting, narrow corridor opens into a vast stone archway carved with fractal runes. The air here is thick with shimmering distortion, as if the fabric of reality is thin. Subtle vibrations can be felt through the floor, and voices sometimes echo--your own, but warped and unfamiliar. The ground is broken by a simple, deceptive pressure plate and the faint outline of a circular sigil. Beyond the arch, the path leads deeper into the unreality of the Warrens.
location.dmInstructions: This is the main entry point. The trap is visible to careful investigation. The Veil Wraith is a minor but memorable encounter. Environmental hazards (shifting gravity, spatial loops) can be introduced here.

doors.description: A massive arch inscribed with shimmering fractal sigils, the boundary between the mundane and the warped.
doors.name: Grand Archway

encounters.description: A Veil Wraith emerges if the party lingers or makes noise. Unsettling echoes may force Wisdom saving throws (DC 12) to avoid mild confusion.

features.description: A cramped, winding corridor where the walls seem to flex and breathe.
features.name: Narrow Passage

features.description: A monumental stone arch inscribed with fractal runes, shimmering with unstable energy.
features.name: Grand Archway

lootTable: Crystaline lens (acts as a one-use Detect Magic)
Fragment of a mask with shifting patterns
Scroll of Misty Step (written in mirrored script)

monsters.description: A slithering, translucent aberration that phases in and out of existence, seeking to drag intruders into the cracks between worlds.
monsters.name: Veil Wraith
monsters.stats: Use Wraith or Shadow with teleport ability (bonus action, 15 ft.)

location.name: Veilsplit Threshold
plotHooks: The threshold's runes hint at a ritual to stabilize the passage--potentially useful deeper within.
Scraps of clothing and a dropped insignia suggest someone recently passed through in haste.
A psychic echo reveals a moment of betrayal connected to the deeper shrine.

traps.description: A hidden pressure plate that triggers when stepped on.
traps.name: Simple Pressure Plate
